# ITU-R Reports — a publication series that numbers independently of
# Recommendations, so the leading word is part of the identifier.
# Byte-exact round-trip forms only; the infix "ITU-R Report BT.2020-1"
# spelling normalizes to the leading form and lives in report_spec.rb.

Report ITU-R BT.2020-1 (2000)
Report ITU-R BT.2025
Report ITU-R M.2083-0 (09/2015)
Report ITU-R M.2134 (2008)
Report ITU-R P.2145-2 (08/2017)
Report ITU-R RS.2165 (2009)
Report ITU-R F.2086-1
Report ITU-R 2205
Report ITU-R BT.2020-1-F
Report ITU-R BT.2020-1 Suppl. 1
Report ITU-R BT.2020-1 Annex A
Report ITU-R M.2134 (2008) Cor. 1 (10/2009)
